info.title: Follow the Rupee: Backend
info.description:
Pre-Payment Audit Gate + Citizen Rupee Receipt for Mumbai monsoon road repairs (synthetic dataset).

Every number is computed by the pipelines (`audit_engine/run_audit.py`, `scorecard_planner/run_pipeline.py`); endpoints only select and shape. Flags are labelled *Needs Explanation* or *Recoverable under DLP*, and every flag carries `evidence_row_ids`. Amounts are whole rupees (INR). No login.

get.summary: Localities (with aliases) for the citizen picker
Free-text landmark/road lookup -> road receipt
get.description:
View 4 deterministic lookup: free text -> road receipt + the 3 nearest roads with their latest work order.
Tries a road name in the text first ("Andheri subway ke bahar..."), then any locality name/alias/Devanagari.
Fuzzy/vernacular parsing beyond this is the Claude /api/citizen-query layer's job.

post.summary: Citizen question -> plain-language answer (Claude, template fallback)
post.description:
Resolves the text like /api/lookup, then Claude rewrites the precomputed facts as a 3-5 sentence answer in the
requested language. Falls back to a template if Claude is slow/unavailable or cites an ID not in the facts.

post.summary: Submit citizen report (server sets tracker status)
post.description:
View 4 report. The server resolves the road (road_id -> location within 500 m -> landmark/text), links the latest
matching work order, detects a duplicate (same road + issue in 7 days) and sets the tracker status; anon clients
cannot set it. contact_phone is stored privately and never returned.

get.summary: Monthly contractor scorecards: separate speed / SLA / durability / cost ranks
get.description:
One block per month; every contractor-month carries four independent ranks (null when its own sample
is below the methodology minimum, with the reason in `rank_eligibility`), known/missing denominators,
descriptive context, and the work-order IDs used as evidence. No composite score.
